Title: Application loads successfully
Preconditions: User opens the app in a browser
Test Steps: 1. Launch the app. 2. Wait for the homepage to render.
Expected Result: Header is visible; Home page content renders; no blank screen or crash.

Title: Header navigation visible on all pages
Preconditions: User is on any valid page
Expected Result: GlobalTaste brand and links for Home, Search, Categories, Favorites, Planner, Basket, and Surprise Me are visible.

Title: Home navigation works
Expected Result: URL updates to home route; Home page heading and content display.

Title: Search page navigation works
Expected Result: Search route opens; Search heading displays; user can search meals.

Title: Categories page navigation works
Expected Result: Categories route opens; category/cuisine view displays.

Title: Favorites page navigation works
Expected Result: Favorites route opens; saved items or empty state display.

Title: Planner page navigation works
Expected Result: Planner route opens; meal planning view displays.

Title: Basket page navigation works
Expected Result: Basket route opens; selected meals or empty state display.

Title: Surprise Me page navigation works
Expected Result: Surprise route opens; random meal suggestion displays.

Title: Meal Details page loads with meal ID
Expected Result: Meal Details heading appears; selected meal ID is displayed.

Title: Meal Details page handles missing ID gracefully
Preconditions: User navigates to a malformed detail route
Expected Result: No crash; fallback or empty state appears.

Title: Main layout persists across navigation
Expected Result: Header and footer remain visible; only main content changes.

Title: Footer content is present
Expected Result: Footer contains GlobalTaste branding and copyright text.

Title: Browser refresh works on route pages
Preconditions: User is on a route page such as /categories
Expected Result: App shell and selected route remain intact after reload.

Title: Active navigation state works
Preconditions: User navigates to Search or another page
Expected Result: Current page link is visually highlighted.

Title: Unknown route handling
Expected Result: Not-found page or safe redirect appears; no broken UI.

Title: Search input behavior works
Test Steps: 1. Type a meal keyword into search field.
Expected Result: Input accepts text and shows entered value for search/filtering.

Title: Favorite action can be triggered
Preconditions: User opens a meal result or detail
Expected Result: Favorite state toggles and meal is saved to favorites.

Title: Meal selection opens details
Preconditions: User is on a meal list or card
Expected Result: User is redirected to the meal detail route with correct meal data.

Title: Surprise feature returns a valid recommendation
Expected Result: A valid meal suggestion is returned and displayed.

Title: No results returned from search
Preconditions: User searches for a non-matching keyword
Test Steps: 1. Enter a keyword with no results.
Expected Result: Empty-state message displays; app remains stable.

Title: Duplicate favorites prevented
Test Steps: 1. Add the same meal to favorites twice.
Expected Result: Meal appears only once in favorites list.

Title: Basket empty state
Expected Result: Meaningful empty-state message is displayed.

Title: Meal detail loading state handles delay
Preconditions: Slow API response for meal details
Expected Result: Loading indicator appears while data is pending.

Title: Invalid meal ID handled gracefully
Preconditions: User navigates to an invalid meal ID
Test Steps: 1. Visit a meal route with an unknown ID.
Expected Result: User sees a meaningful error or not-found message; app remains stable.
